# agents

Sensor agents and agent groups.

- Toolset name: `agents`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 14 (6 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_clone_agent_group`

**Clone agent group** · mutating

Clone an agent group. Returns the UUID of the copy.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_create_agent_group`

**Create agent group** · mutating

Create an agent group. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_ids` | array<string> | no | UUIDs of member agents |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `name` | string | yes | Group name |
| `scheduler_cron_time` | string | yes | Scheduler cron expression for the group |

### `openvas_delete_agent`

**Delete agent** · destructive

Delete an agent (no trashcan).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_delete_agent_group`

**Delete agent group** · destructive

Delete an agent group (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_get_agent_group`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_get_agent_installer_instruction`

**Get agent installer instruction** · read-only

Get the installer instructions for enrolling an agent with a scanner.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `language` | string | no | Instruction language: en or de |
| `origin_url` | string | yes | Absolute origin URL used in the generated instructions |
| `scanner_id` | string | yes | Scanner UUID the agent will report to |

### `openvas_get_agent_support_bundle`

**Get agent support bundle** · read-only

Download an agent's support bundle (returned base64-encoded, up to 3 MB).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `days` | integer | no | Limit the bundle to the most recent number of days (min 0) |
| `encryption` | boolean | no | Request backend encryption of the bundle (omit for the default) |
| `id` | string | yes | Agent UUID |

### `openvas_list_agent_groups`

**List agent groups** · read-only

List agent groups. `trash` lists trashed ones.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |
| `trash` | boolean | no | List trashed resources instead of active ones |

### `openvas_list_agents`

**List agents** · read-only

List sensor agents with status, version and authorization.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_sync_agents`

**Sync agents** · mutating

Trigger a synchronization of agents with the agent controller.

This tool takes no parameters.

### `openvas_update_agent`

**Update agent** · destructive

Authorize, update or reconfigure an agent. Idempotent (PUT).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authorized` | boolean | no | Authorize (true) or revoke (false) the agent |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `config` | any | no | Agent configuration update object (agentControl.retry, agentScriptExecutor, heartbeat), as in the gateway's AgentConfigUpdate |
| `id` | string | yes | Agent UUID |
| `update_to_latest` | boolean | no | Request an update to the latest agent version |

### `openvas_update_agent_control_scan_config`

**Update agent-control scan config** · destructive

Change the default agent configuration of an agent-control scan config. Idempotent (PUT).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_defaults` | any | no | Default agent configuration (AgentConfigUpdate object) |
| `id` | string | yes | Agent-control scan config UUID |
| `update_to_latest` | boolean | no | Update agents to the latest version by default |

### `openvas_update_agent_group`

**Update agent group** · destructive

Update an agent group. Idempotent (PUT); the scheduler cron time is always required by the gateway.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_ids` | array<string> | no | Replacement member agent UUIDs |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `id` | string | yes | Group UUID |
| `name` | string | no |  |
| `scheduler_cron_time` | string | yes | Scheduler cron expression (required by the gateway on every update) |
